title: Pricing
snippet:
By default, users have access to the Workers Free plan. The Workers Free plan includes limited usage of Workers, Pages Functions, Workers KV and Hyperdrive. Read more about the [Free plan limits](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/#account-plan-limits).
The Workers Paid plan includes Workers, Pages Functions, Workers KV, Hyperdrive, and Durable Objects usage for a minimum charge of $5 USD per month for an account. The plan includes increased initial usage allotments, with clear charges for usage that exceeds the base plan. There are no additional charges for data transfer (egress) or throughput (bandwidth).
All included usage is on a monthly basis.

| | Requests1, 2, 3, 4 | Duration | CPU time |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Free** | 100,000 per day | No charge for duration | 10 milliseconds of CPU time per invocation |
| **Standard** | 10 million included per month +$0.30 per additional million | No charge or limit for duration | 30 million CPU milliseconds included per month +$0.02 per additional million CPU milliseconds Max of [5 minutes of CPU time](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/#account-plan-limits) per invocation (default: 30 seconds) Max of [15 minutes of CPU time](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/#cpu-time) per [Cron Trigger](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/configuration/cron-triggers/) invocation for intervals of 1 hour or more |

| | Workers Free | Workers Paid |

| Standard operations | 10,000 operations/day included | 1,000,000 operations/month included + $0.40/million operations |

title: Cloudflare API Gateway Pricing 2026: API Shield, Workers & Free Tier Breakdown
snippet:
The free plan carries 100,000 Workers requests a day, permanently, which is roughly three million a month at an even rate. Workers Paid is $5/month with 10 million requests included, then $0.30 per additional million. Zero data transfer fees across the board. Here is what it actually costs, when it wins, and when it does not.
Cloudflare API Gateway pricing summary (2026)
Free
$0/mo
100,000 requests/day, permanent
Workers Paid
$5/mo
10M included, then $0.30/M
Business
$200/mo
Billed annually ($250 monthly); WAF and priority support
Enterprise (Contract)
Custom
No published rate; API Shield sold here
Data transfer (egress) is $0 on every tier.

## Cloudflare Pricing Tiers (2026)
Free
$0/mo
- 100,000 requests/day permanently
- Zero data transfer fees
- Basic DDoS protection
- No credit card required
- Workers runtime (10 ms CPU time per invocation)
Workers Paid
$5/mo
- 10M requests/month included
- $0.30/million beyond 10M
- Zero data transfer fees
- 30M CPU-milliseconds included, then $0.02/million
- Cron triggers, Durable Objects
- Basic rate limiting
Business / Enterprise
$200+/mo
- Custom request volume
- Enterprise rates negotiated, none published
- API Shield sold as an Enterprise add-on
- Advanced WAF + mTLS
- Priority support + SLA
- 100% uptime SLA on Business and Contract
Re-checked 23 September 2026. Workers Paid is a $5/month minimum for the account (10M requests and 30M CPU-milliseconds included, then $0.30/million requests and $0.02/million CPU-ms), per [Cloudflare's Workers pricing docs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing/). Business is $200/month billed annually ($250 monthly) per [cloudflare.com/plans](https://www.cloudflare.com/plans/). Enterprise (Contract) pricing is negotiated and Cloudflare publishes no rate card for it.

What Cloudflare includes for free
- Zero outbound data transfer charges ([see EgressCost.com](https://www.egresscost.com))
- DDoS protection (all plans, including free)
- Edge caching (served from 300+ PoPs)
- HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 support
- SSL/TLS certificate management
- IPv6 support
What costs extra on Cloudflare
- Logpush (log streaming): $0.05/million events
- Workers KV storage: $0.50/GB stored
- Durable Objects: $0.15/million requests
- R2 object storage: $0.015/GB stored
- Advanced API Shield (schema validation, mTLS enforcement)
- Priority support (requires Business or Enterprise)

| Feature | Cloudflare | AWS API Gateway |
|---|---|---|
| Free tier | 100,000 requests/day, permanent | 1M/mo
